# What the store keeps, and how a version is served

`file_to_artifact` keeps a file that is UTF-8, at most 2,097,152 bytes
(2 MiB), and opens with one of `<!doctype html`, `<html`, in any case.

Every version is served with this `Content-Security-Policy`, one directive per line:

```text
sandbox allow-scripts
default-src 'none'
script-src 'unsafe-inline'
style-src 'unsafe-inline'
img-src data: blob:
font-src data:
media-src data: blob:
connect-src 'none'
form-action 'none'
base-uri 'none'
```
